Let \(x = T - 2 \pmod{24}\). Then the poster is true exactly when \(x\) and \(x+3\) are in the same 12-hour activity interval.

- If \(x \in [0,9)\), both \(x\) and \(x+3\) are in awake time.
- If \(x \in [9,12)\), the two times are in different intervals.
- If \(x \in [12,21)\), both are in sleeping time.
- If \(x \in [21,24)\), the two times are in different intervals.

Thus the truth interval length is \(9+9=18\) hours per day.

\[
\boxed{18}
\]
